# Coffee AI | Product Overview

Coffee AI is an AI-first sales CRM that can be used independently or as a companion layer to Salesforce or HubSpot, with a focus on eliminating post-entry and post-meeting administration. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
